comment: Halogenation of the coupled aglycone containing ring A and B in the clorobiocin pathway. Bromine has higher affinity to CloHal but yields less bromobiocin due to lower turnover rate. Iodination and fluorination not possible

reactions.description: Chlorination of ring B of the aglycone intermediate
C-8 chlorination of the aminocoumarin moiety
Bromination of ring B of the aglycone intermediate
C-8 bromination of the aminocoumarin moiety
